features.description: Introduce an evaluation through a short parallel series of guiding questions.
Mark the evidential maturity of a generalization and distinguish observations, tendencies, and established results.
Present categories in compact parallel grammatical forms so their differences remain visually comparable.
State the practical consequence of a condition directly, then explain the evidence or mechanism behind it.
Move from a general observation to examples, a bounded contrast, and a resulting implication through restrained connective language.
Keep the response focused on the single review decision.
Use ordinary transitions between supplied propositions.
Prefer direct sentences with clear subjects and actions.
State a supplied evidence limitation once without additional evaluation.
End with a concise restatement of the supplied decision.
Uses numbered taxonomies, paired alternatives, and repeated grammatical frames to present distinctions as ordered sets.
Uses dense causal connectives to make reasoning explicit, repeatedly linking condition, mechanism, consequence, and response.
Alternates dense explanatory runs with short labels, compact lists, and parallel fragments, producing emphatic bursts of compression.
Builds extended sentences through stacked complement, relative, conditional, and causal clauses, allowing a claim, rationale, exception, and consequence to occupy one syntactic unit.
Develops claims additively through examples, restatements, and further considerations, favoring cumulative elaboration over abrupt topic changes.
Acknowledge the valid portion of an objection before identifying the narrower point of disagreement.
Frame a disagreement as two opposing concerns before addressing either side.
Compress a longer distinction into a short parallel summary after the detailed explanation.
State the speaker's current practice, uncertainty, or limitation directly instead of presenting every conclusion impersonally.
Interrupt formal analysis with a compact analogy, aside, or lightly humorous clarification.

task: Assign each anonymous card to exactly one candidate practice and explain the profile cues used.
